title: Planning Monday's Village Gate concert; replacing the trumpeter
summary: Gil says he will have fifteen players for Monday's concert and must replace Marvin Peterson, who is going to Sweden.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Oh that's right, it's this Monday night isn't it? Will you be using many of the same people I saw at Henry Street? How many people
are you going to have by the way?
Weeee! You'll blow them out of there. (LAUGHTER). I don't know where you are going to put them.
Oh, wait a minute, I'm thinking about the, I keep thinking about the Vanguard.

It was going to be on Top of the Gate but now it's going to be downstairs. They have changed it, it holds 450 people so, and the stage is big and they've got a new sound system, so maybe..... I think I'll have a lot of the same players. Marvin can't make it, he's going to Sweden.
He's the trumpet player, Oh he's going to Sweden?

Yes. He's going to Sweden next Monday. His wife is from Sweden and they want to go home for Christmas. They've already made the plane reservations and she works for an airline, so apparently it's the day they have to go.
Oh? Between now and Monday you've got to find out, huh?
died Kenny Durham/two weeks ago. I would have called Kenny. I called him before, he worked with me at ~~slug's~~ Slug's . . . ?).
Yes, I know Jimmy, he's fine.
